name: MARLIN venue attribution - Semantic Scholar graph API batch response
notes: Semantic Scholar graph API, fields=venue,publicationVenue,year,journal for arXiv:2408.11743, retrieved 2026-10-04. Returns venue 'ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles & Practice of Parallel Programming', year 2024, journal {'name': 'Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGPLAN Annual Symposium on Principles and Practice of Parallel Programming'}. The ACM DL page itself returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, so the PPoPP proceedings listing was NOT independently confirmed - this attribution rests on the S2 record plus the arXiv title match. PPoPP is not a member of the paper schema's venue enum, hence venue='other' with the real venue named here and in the record notes.
